- **Hinjewadi IT Park Phase 1**: 10 minutes (3.5 km)
- **Hinjewadi IT Park Phase 2 & 3**: 15–20 minutes

## 4. Construction Technology & Structural Superiority

Krisala Aventis Tathawade employs **100% Aluform (Aluminium Formwork) Construction Technology**:
- **Monolithic Shear Walls**: Seamless concrete casting of walls and slabs simultaneously, eliminating brickwork joints.
- **Zero Seepage & Leakage**: High waterproofing integrity compared to traditional brick-and-mortar masonry.
- **Earthquake Resistance**: Engineered to withstand Zone III seismic loads with maximum structural stiffness.
- **Carpet Area Efficiency**: Thinner, high-strength shear walls maximize usable indoor carpet area.
